name: SkillState Shared Knowledge Seed
notes: Career graphs are shared destination knowledge, not learner-specific plans.
Transitions are computed from shared canonical capability IDs; overlap is descriptive, not a suitability score.
Resource entries are curated starting points. The application should validate URLs periodically and add freshness metadata.
Career core should be refreshed slowly; opportunities and fast-changing signals belong in separate live libraries.
v1.1 closes all direct learning-resource coverage gaps for capabilities used by the seeded careers.
A capability being covered means at least one relevant resource exists; it does not mean the library is exhaustive or that every learner should receive that resource.
Prefer official sources; trusted industry/educational sources are marked sourceType=trusted.
